title: Faculty of Health Sciences 2027 Postdoctoral Fellowship
institution: University of Cape Town, Faculty of Health Sciences
field: Health sciences (cardiac research, cancer research, open category)
about: The University of Cape Town's Faculty of Health Sciences offers 2027 postdoctoral fellowships in three areas: cardiac research, cancer research and an open category. Hosts or supervisors submit documentation to the Faculty Research Office by 6 November 2026.
requirements: Documentation submitted directly to the Faculty of Health Sciences Research Office by the host/supervisor

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Health sciences (cardiac research, cancer research, open category)" (postdoctoral research) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Seniority: Postdoctoral" (independent research output) → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."

The photo shows elephant statues in front of the Palace of the Lost City at Sun City, South Africa (a country photo, not Cape Town).
